sheets.title: DETAILS
sheets.reading_notes: Single-sheet electrical detail set for LPD NNS Welding Services. Contains four distinct diagrams: (1) ONE LINE DIAGRAM — depicts 34.5kV overhead 3φ 4W primary service feeding through a fused cutout (60A USLD) and 27kV arrestors to a pad-mounted MU12 transformer (4000/3 main, 85kV insulation), then to a 4000A, 277/480V, NEMA 3R main switchboard with multiple 800A/3 main breakers and 400A/3 branch breakers plus spares, distributing via 10 4-inch conduits (including 2 spares) to 7 service rack locations. (2) TRANSFORMER SWITCHBOARD — plan/elevation view of pad-mounted transformer and associated NEMA 3R 4000A, 480/277V, 3φ, 4W switchboard on concrete pad. (3) SERVICE RACK TYPICAL 6 — detail of 400A, 277/480V, 3φ, 4W panelboard on exterior plywood/treated-post rack with four 100A breakers serving 200A outlets (two) and 100A outlets (two); note flags rack may use owner-furnished transformer. (4) SERVICE LOCATIONS 1-7 — right-panel detail showing 400A panelboard serving 200A RS 3φ 4W outlets (typ of 2) and 100A RS 3φ 4W outlets (typ of 4) via discrete branch breakers, panel wall-mounted on plywood backboard. SIDE VIEW CONDUIT RACK detail also shown: 4-inch PVC conduits on galvanized strut supports from grade. All details are NO SCALE. Drawing is stamped with Virginia PE seal (Bowman Foster & Associates). Title block shows BFA project no. 24-052, date Aug 27, 2024, drawn EAO, checked/project engineer MRD. Contract and client project numbers redacted.
